Date: 10/10/2026
Patient Name: Liam Harris
DOB: 04/17/1970
MRN: MRN-61104

To: Cardiology Clinic Intake
From: Dr. Laura Evans, Lakeside Family Practice

Dear Colleague,

Reason for referral: Evaluation of breathlessness on exertion.

Liam Harris is a 56-year-old man with hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and obesity. He reports gradually worsening breathlessness when walking uphill or climbing stairs over the past three months. He denies breathlessness at rest and has reduced his usual activity because of these symptoms.

I would appreciate your evaluation of his breathlessness on exertion and recommendations for further care.

Thank you for seeing this patient.

Dr. Laura Evans
Lakeside Family Practice
